notes.title: UPDATE V1.0.2
notes.notes:
🌴 New Update is Live!

Hey everyone!
We’ve just released a new update packed with exciting changes and improvements:

🗺️ A New Island Has Been Discovered!
Explore brand new terrain, hidden secrets, and fresh challenges.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
We’ve squashed several bugs to make your gameplay smoother.

🚤 Boat Mechanics Are Now Available!
You can now build and use boats to travel across the waters — time to set sail!

🌍 Map Expansion
The world just got bigger. More to explore, more to survive!

🎨 Graphics Improvements
Visuals have been polished for a better and more immersive experience.

🛠️ Early Preparations for the Second Village
Work has already begun on the upcoming second village — stay tuned for more details in future updates!

Thanks for all your support and feedback — it helps us shape the game for the better.
Enjoy the update and let us know what you think!

notes.title: V1.0.1
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 is Live! Welcome to the Full Release of Fish Market Simulator
After months in Early Access, we’re thrilled to officially launch the full version of Fish Market Simulator! A huge thank you to everyone who played, gave feedback, and helped us shape the game into what it is today.
Here’s what’s new in the 1.0 release:
 Improvements & Fixes
 Fixed: Bait Bug
 Say goodbye to the annoying bait bug! Your fishing experience is now smoother than ever.
 New Features
 Tavern is Now Open
 Take a break from the docks and step into the brand-new tavern!
 Order Your Favorite Drink
 Choose and purchase your drink of choice at the bar—because every fisher deserves a treat.
 Play Darts to Win Gold
 Feeling lucky? Head to the tavern dartboard and test your aim. Win gold and bragging rights!
 Bulk Fish Trading Without Fishing
 No time to fish? No problem! You can now buy fish in bulk from the market and sell them directly for profit.
Buy a New Home and Redecorate Your Life
 Transform your living space—move to a new home and customize your environment to suit your style.
 Dynamic Weather System
 Rain or shine, the weather now changes in real time. Keep an eye on the skies—conditions may affect your market strategies!
We’re incredibly proud of how far Fish Market Simulator has come, and this is only the beginning. Thank you for being part of this journey. Now go, make your fortune on the docks... or at the dartboard!

notes.title: 🐟 Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator | Dev Log
notes.notes:
Hey captains! We’re cooking up a fresh update for Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator, and here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:

🔧 New Gameplay Features – Manage fishing routes, fish quality, and seasonal catches for a deeper experience.
🏘️ Town Expansion – New shops, NPCs, and interactive areas will bring Sea Town to life.
📈 Market Overhaul – Prices will now react to demand, supply, and even weather!
🎨 Visual & UI Improvements – Cleaner design, better guidance for new players.
⚙️ Performance Upgrades – Smoother gameplay and fixes based on your feedback.

Thanks for supporting us — the sea’s full of surprises, and we’re just getting started!
– Sea Town Dev Team
